summary: Iteration 6: verified LIVE Doodstream + VOE host API integration end-to-end. Backend 32/32 pytest pass (added TestHostApiIntegration class - 4 new cases). GET /api/hosts returns DoodStream.api_provider='doodstream' and VOE.api_provider='voe'. GET /api/embed/SMioOAxb: VOE online with embed_url on rotating direct domain (jennifereconomicgive.com/e/rjseg1wmsyv6 - NOT voe.sx); DoodStream online with resolved live domain (playmogo.com/e/9bvi9u4wu0j1 - NOT dsvplay.com). POST /api/mirrors/<SMioOAxb>/check returns both online, resolved_url on the API-provided direct domain, and DoodStream title populated ('Sasha Unleashed (2026)'). Create flow with dsvplay.com/d/9bvi9u4wu0j1 + voe.sx/rjseg1wmsyv6 - after ~8s background resolution both links show status=online with rotating resolved_url; mirror deleted. Regressions all green: URL normalization, geo-ordering (ES/US), Cloudflare-403 not marked offline, admin CRUD, site settings, seeded mirrors preserved. Frontend: /e/SMioOAxb iframe uses referrerPolicy='no-referrer' with NO sandbox; VOE tab loads iframe src on rotating direct domain (jennifereconomicgive.com), DoodStream tab flips to playmogo.com/e/... - both /e/<code> and non-source-domain. Admin > Hosts & Rates > Edit DoodStream reveals data-testid='host-api-provider' select with value 'doodstream' and options ['None (HTTP check only)', 'Doodstream API', 'VOE API']. Note: playmogo.com sends X-Frame-Options=sameorigin which prevents actual playback in iframe headlessly, but this is a downstream host limitation - problem statement explicitly asked to assert embed_url domains/status/title from the API rather than actual playback.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py api_resolve_link(): VOE branch always calls voe_embed_prefix() which does an extra HTTP GET on cache miss; cache is 5min so acceptable, but consider warming the cache on startup to avoid the first-request penalty.

server.py api_resolve_link() Doodstream path: still calls probe_url(embed_url) synchronously to resolve the live rotating domain. This adds ~1s latency per resolve; consider caching resolved DoodStream domain per file_code or checking the file/info response for a domain field to avoid the extra HTTP hop.

server.py _voe_domain_cache is a plain module-level dict with no lock; if two workers hit voe_embed_prefix() simultaneously on cache miss the request will be duplicated. Low-risk MVP but worth an asyncio.Lock or single-flight guard.

resolve_mirror_links(): a single failure inside api_resolve_link is logged but not retried; a transient rate-limit response from doodapi.co (10/s) can leave a link stuck with resolved_url=None until the offline_checker cycles it. Add a bounded retry.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - iframe rotating-domain + tab switch + host-api-provider select verified
